 GREEN BAY (WLUK) -- The Green Bay Police Department says it responded to 29 calls during the Cowboys-Packers game Sunday night at Lambeau Field.
 During the game, officers investigated medical calls and fan code of conduct violations.
 Officers arrested six people and ejected 16 fans.
